description: Topics: essay-editor, semantic-context, packages, affirmation. Starting from the essay home's status: a new essay lacks the argument package its help assumes, and no agent tool defines a type. The owner chose argument as a dependency for now, with agent help to teach it, then described the editor over time: each essay has its own semantic context (contract, story, product marketing), a vignette-to-structured-data view with a tick and bin on derived data, and layers of structure, thinking, references and essays.
title: 2026-11-04 · Each essay has its own semantic context
